messages.body_plain:
Thank you Simone (and Jacob) for flagging this error message. It took a 
little while but I was eventually able to reproduce the error and track 
down the offending command. The current version of the package (1.27) 
has the corrected code. Update with:

update.packages(oldPkgs="tlocoh", repos="http://R-Forge.R-project.org")

or

install.packages("tlocoh", repos = "http://R-Forge.R-project.org")

As always, please forward me cryptic error messages so we can track down 
the problem and keep improving the package.

Andy
